# Maia Team overview

[Maia Team](https://www.matillion.com/maia) is comprised of expert AI agents that help you to plan, build, refactor, optimize, and troubleshoot data pipelines in Maia. Whether you're creating new workflows or optimizing existing ones, Maia Team accelerates your work with powerful, natural language capabilities.

[YouTube video player](https://www.youtube.com/embed/4K7R5rY-B24?si=CyPcdPgNH5SuTnE5\&enablejsapi=1)

***

## Enabling Maia Team

Maia Team is enabled at account level by default in Maia, so you can start prompting it straight away. This means that by default, all users within your organization can ask Maia Team for help building pipelines, creating custom connectors, and more. It also means that Maia Team can sample data in any pipelines in your Maia account.

You can disable Maia Team as a whole, including Mission Control and Context Engine, or just its ability to sample data, at the account level. To do this, go to your [account details](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/administration/manage-accounts.md#edit-account-details), and use the **Enable AI Agents** and **Enable AI Agent sampling** toggles to enable or disable these features.

If Maia Team is enabled at account level, users with the **Member** role cannot manage account-level settings for Maia Team, but all other users can. For more information, see [Account role permissions](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/administration/account-roles.md#role-permissions).

***

## What can Maia Team do?

The tasks that Maia Team can perform for you include:

### Pipeline development and design

* Build orchestration pipelines to extract and load data from various sources into your data warehouse.
* [Create custom connectors](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/create-a-custom-connector-with-maia.md) for your orchestration pipelines.
* Find available [shared pipelines](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/shared-pipelines.md) and use them by adding [Run Shared Pipeline](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/run-shared-pipeline.md) components to orchestration pipelines.
* Create transformation pipelines to transform, cleanse, aggregate, and enrich your data.
* Design modular workflows by creating reusable, maintainable pipelines with variables and nested pipeline execution.
* Validate and run pipelines from within the chat panel.
* Manage pipeline and project variables for dynamic, reusable configurations.
* Configure iterator and loop components for repeating tasks over datasets.
* Disable and re-enable orchestration components without removing them from the pipeline.

### Data exploration and visualization

* Query your data warehouse to explore tables, views, and schemas.
* Sample pipeline data to preview data at any stage of your pipeline without full execution.
* [Visualize data in charts](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/maia-sessions-and-tools.md#visualizing-data) directly in the chat panel to understand trends and patterns.
* [Search your projects](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/maia-sessions-and-tools.md#file-exploration) to find specific content, such as configuration details, across all your files.
* Validate pipeline components against your warehouse to catch configuration errors before execution.

### Project and file management

* Move and rename files to maintain clean folder structures.
* Copy files, e.g. for use as templates for similar workflows.
* Delete obsolete files to clean up unused pipelines and configurations.
* Commit changes and push to your remote Git branch with auto-generated commit messages.
* View uncommitted changes and diffs to review work before committing.

### Pipeline analysis and optimization

* Explain what your existing pipelines do, their components, and how they work.
* Identify problems in pipeline configurations and suggest fixes.
* Improve performance by recommending best practices for parallel execution, component selection, and workflow efficiency.

### Consultation and best practices

* Answer questions about your projects, Designer components, and features of Maia.
* Advise on pipeline organization and data engineering.
* Provide low-code expertise to help you leverage specialized components instead of custom SQL.
* Create and maintain to-do lists for complex tasks so you can keep track of your progress.

***

## Chat history

In Designer, Maia Team automatically saves your conversations, making it easy to continue where you left off or revisit previous work. This ensures that important context and progress aren't lost when you need to step away or switch tasks.

Your conversation history with Maia Team is kept for two years. [None of your data is used to train third-party AI models or to enhance Matillion's AI services](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/ai-faq.md#does-matillion-use-my-data-to-train-third-party-ai-models).

Your conversation history is unique to your current branch. Switching to a different branch, e.g. from `main` to `developer-1`, will show your conversations on that branch. You can never view another user's conversations with Maia Team, even if that user has worked on the same branch as you.

The 10 most recent conversations on your branch are available for you to resume, rename or delete.

***

## Limitations

Working with Maia Team is currently subject to the following limitations:

* Maia Team can't schedule or [publish](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/schedules.md) pipelines.
* Maia Team can find available [shared pipelines](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/shared-pipelines.md) and add [Run Shared Pipeline](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/run-shared-pipeline.md) components to use them, but can't create or publish shared pipelines.
* [Git integration](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/git-overview.md) is partial. Maia Team can generate commit messages, commit changes, and push to a branch. However, it cannot perform advanced Git operations such as creating branches, resolving conflicts, or managing pull requests.
